variable_field_encoding.string: uint16 byte_length + UTF-8 bytes, no NUL terminator
variable_field_encoding.embedded_record: uint16 record_type + uint16 schema_version + uint32 body_length + body bytes
variable_field_encoding.rule: Variable fields appear after root block in schema order.

crc_policy.covered_bytes: entire frame header + payload, excluding CRC trailer
crc_policy.required_for: all critical messages; snapshot frames; durable journal/replay; golden fixtures

messages.name: SNAPSHOT_CHUNK
notes: Embedded records contain payload bodies only, not nested KAT1 frame headers.

messages.name: TICK_EVENT
notes: bid/ask required for tradable tick; last/volume controlled by presence_flags.

messages.name: SYMBOL_SPEC
notes: Tick value/margins are in broker-native account/deposit currency where MT5 reports them.
Any material economic rule change increments spec_revision.

messages.name: OPEN_INTENT
notes: sl_units is mandatory and nonzero for any intent that can create live exposure.
LIMIT/STOP require requested_price_units and finite pending_valid_until_ns.
STOP_LIMIT is reserved and rejected in V1.
On netting accounts, approved_position_revision and expected_position_effect are mandatory guards.

messages.name: BROKER_CALC_REQUEST
notes: Used as broker-native OrderCalcProfit/OrderCalcMargin evidence for deterministic sizing/preflight.
